title: MCP integration tests
summary: Invoke the real MCP server through a client and verify tool contracts end to end.
description: Test the MCP adapter as consumed by Claude Code rather than calling internal helpers directly. Start the real MCP server with an isolated planner context and use the MCP SDK client with in-memory transport or a subprocess transport. Cover project/feature/phase/task/requirement CRUD, validation and error messages, composite and short references, status transitions, checklist and reorder operations, repair/integrity, handoff preparation proposal, explicit phase targeting, confirmed handoff writes, archive listing, and planner-web lifecycle where available. Assert that tool outputs are actionable, never leak raw UUIDs when a composite reference exists, and do not mutate state when a proposal or validation fails. Preserve MCP schemas and compatibility with existing Claude Code command routing.

tasks.title: Build real MCP client/server integration harness
tasks.description:
Create a test harness that starts the actual @agent-plan/mcp server against an isolated planner and connects an MCP SDK client through in-memory transport or a controlled subprocess. Provide helpers for tool discovery, invocation, structured-content extraction, error assertions, and cleanup. Ensure tests validate the published MCP schema surface rather than importing private handler functions.

---
**Completion summary:**
Independent review approved. Added reusable real MCP stdio fixture helpers in `test/helpers/mcp-fixture.mjs` and `packages/plan-mcp/test/mcp-harness.test.mjs` (6 tests). The harness starts the published MCP entrypoint in a subprocess against real planner data and covers public schema discovery, CRUD persistence, structured results, semantic/schema failures, handoff confirmation, init, and idempotent teardown. Personally verified 6/6 targeted, `pnpm check`, and full build suite 300/300. No commit/push.

tasks.title: Test MCP handoff proposal and confirmation contract

Test replacement archival, terminal-phase rejection, active/archive listing, clear/read behavior, composite references, and absence of implicit first-in-progress fallback. Assert proposal responses are actionable and contain the exact target the agent should present to the user.
